items.text:
Goal: pressure from the first back, win the mid-game,
highest skill ceiling. 14 build paths, bought with the same gold,
run through a fight model with LoL wiki numbers (patch 26.22).
Runes: the runes page's default (Stormraider's Surge).
Win rates: tab 6 only (patch 16.21). Pulled 2026-11-07.

Item 2: time to
kill an ADC

• Default: Nashor's Tooth → Dusk and Dawn → Rabadon's,
Sorcerer's Shoes. At item 2 it kills an ADC in 1.3 s.
On-hit builds need 2.1 to 2.3 s. That gap is the
mid-game.
• Nashor's before Dusk. Its 50% attack speed gives W
more hits: +10% item 1 damage, same kill time. Dusk
second still makes every spell an extra W hit.
• Into a frontline, or for the strongest early lane:
Rageblade → Nashor's → Dusk. Best item 1 (2,915
damage) and the best 3-item teamfight short of Navori.
• Kraken → Rageblade → Terminus is the most damage
over 8 s at items 2 and 3, and the safest duel. Fewest
decisions, though.
• Every top path is close. A gap under ~10% here is a
lean, not a result.

Each path buys with the same gold: 1,300 (first back), 3,500 (item 1, level 9), 7,400 (item 2, level 11), 10,600 (item 3, level 14), plus a Doran's.
Damage = Q, E, R, R and one 8 s W on an enemy ADC with no defensive items. Tank = 3,600 HP, 170 armor, 120 MR, 16 s with W recast.
Sorted by goal: first back + item 1 once, item 2 twice, item 3 once, skill ceiling once. Skill ceiling is a judgment (tab 5). Bars start at 50% of the best.
Q + 4 autos with W = a lane trade. 8 s = an all-in. Open field = a diver one item ahead dashes at you.
1,000 g · builds into Kraken, Ruined King
1,175 g · builds into Rageblade, Ruined King
1,150 g · builds into Dusk and Dawn
Same path, three boots. Kill time on an ADC / 16 s on a tank.

• The first back barely changes damage: every option lands
within ~15% of the best all-in.
• Boots buy time. Without them the diver reaches you at 2.0 s,
with them at 9.0 s, after your W is over. At level 6 a diver
one item ahead still wins once he arrives, so that time is for
your support, Flash or tower.
• Buy: Recurve Bow + Dagger + Boots (on-hit or Nashor's).
Recurve Bow's 15 on-hit damage is the most pressure per gold,
and every path below wants it.
• Sorcerer's Shoes cut the item 2 kill time on every path: W,
Q, E and R are all magic. Berserker's win longer fights.
Gluttonous is the safe pick, not the aggressive one.

Level 6 Kog (W rank 3) vs a level 6 enemy ADC. Diver at level 6: 1,800 HP, 375 speed, dashes 300 at the start, then 450 burst and 280 damage per second once he reaches you.
Kog kites: stands only for his attack windup, then walks back. Stormraider's fires after 25% of the diver's HP in 3 s.
Time to kill an enemy ADC
Seconds, lower is better. Same spells for every build.
Damage in 8 s, vs the classic build
Compared with Rageblade → Ruined King → Terminus. Above the line = more.
Gold: first back 1,300 · item 1 3,500 · item 2 7,400 · item 3 10,600 (same for every path). Target: an enemy ADC of the same level, no defensive items.

• Rageblade first, not Ruined King: +34% item 1 damage.
Ruined King is a second item for duels and tanks.
• Nashor's before Dusk: +10% at item 1. Same story in the
hybrid: Rageblade → Nashor's beats Rageblade → Dusk at item
2 (5,278 vs 4,751).
• Navori third, not second. Second it is the weakest item 2
(4,018 vs 5,497 for Terminus). Third it wins long fights: W
is back almost the moment it ends (15,426 on the tank, the
most of any path).
• Shadowflame second gives the fastest item 2 kill (1.0 s)
and the weakest teamfight (8,474 on the tank). Into five
squishies only.
• Rabadon's costs 3,500: it lands later than any other third
item. With Shadowflame first it was not done by level 14.
• Lich Bane and Stormsurge first are the weakest item 1s
(1,951 and 2,019). No attack speed, and Kog's damage is in
his autos.
A fed diver dashes at you: who dies first?
Diver one item ahead. Level 9: 2,600 HP, 100 armor. Level 11: 3,300 HP, 130 armor. Dash 300, then burst + steady damage.

• Item 1 is the danger zone. Slowed, 14 of 14 paths
die to a fed diver. Respect divers until item 2.
• Item 2 flips it: 13 of 14 paths win slowed. Most
never get reached, because Stormraider's fires
mid-chase and you outrun him.
• Items with move speed (Lich Bane, Stormsurge,
Kraken) stack with Stormraider's. So does Ruined
King's slow on every third hit.
• Dusk and Dawn's 300 HP and heals are the only real
buffer on a damage path. Wit's End is the swap into
a magic diver.
• Limits: the diver has one dash and no knock-up.
Real assassins (Syndra, Qiyana, Yone) skip the
chase: see the "carry into fed assassins" page.

Diver after reaching you: 1000 burst then 600 damage per second at level 11 (60% physical), against Kog's armor and MR. Kog keeps attacking; his heals count.
Each build uses its best spell timing (front-loaded or spaced for Spellblade). "wins, X% HP left" = Kog's HP when the diver dies.
Most games. Squishy enemies, skirmishes from item 2 on.
Doran's · first back (small icons) · item 1 · boots · item 2 · item 3

Item 1: 2,454 damage in 8 s
Item 2: an ADC dead in 1.3 s
Item 3: 11,292 on the tank in 16 s

• Kills an ADC in 1.3 s at item 2, the fastest of the full
builds that also hold up in teamfights.
• Nashor's first: attack speed and on-hit for W. Dusk
second: every spell becomes another W hit and a heal.
• Skill: weave a spell before an auto every 1.5 s for
Spellblade, and choose burst (Q E R at once) or spaced
spells per fight.
• Rabadon's third: +30% AP on everything. Late: Shadowflame
or Void Staff.
A frontline to chew through, or a lane you want to win at level 9.
Doran's · first back (small icons) · item 1 · boots · item 2 · item 3

Item 1: 2,915 damage in 8 s
Item 2: an ADC dead in 2.0 s
Item 3: 14,294 on the tank in 16 s

• Best item 1 (2,915 damage in 8 s) and 14,294 on the tank
at item 3.
• Rageblade's phantom hit, Dusk's second on-hit and Nashor's
AP all multiply W's % HP damage.
• Swap Berserker's for Sorcerer's when the enemy is squishy:
faster kills, less sustained damage.
• Late: Terminus, then Navori for near-permanent W.
Divers and bruisers who walk at you. The simplest to play.
Doran's · first back (small icons) · item 1 · boots · item 2 · item 3

Item 1: 2,833 damage in 8 s
Item 2: an ADC dead in 2.1 s
Item 3: 13,930 on the tank in 16 s

• Most damage over 8 s at items 2 and 3 (5,527 at item 2).
Wins every slowed duel at item 2 here.
• Kraken's every-third-hit burst grows on low targets, and
its move speed stacks with Stormraider's.
• Lower ceiling: mostly stand and hit. Time Kraken's third
hit for the finish.
• Late: Navori, then Wit's End or a defensive item.

Defensive swaps: Wit's End into magic divers,
Mercurial or Banshee's into one key CC spell,
Jak'Sho when you are the target.
See the "carry into fed assassins" page.

Skill ceiling judgments: Spellblade paths 4 to 5 (spell-auto weaving, burst vs spaced, R mana).
Kraken, Ruined King and Navori 3 (count hits, use the slow, spend the resets). Stormsurge 3 (hit the 25% threshold).
Rageblade, Terminus and Wit's End 2 (stand and hit).
Legendary items · coachless, NA Diamond+, patch 16.21 (2,036 games)
Context only. WPA = win rate minus the win chance when the item was bought. Bar = buys. Noise on ~500 buys is about ±4 points.
AP vs on-hit build · u.gg, NA, patch 26.21
Share of games by finished build variant. Buckets overlap.

Most common cores.
AP: Dusk and Dawn, Sorcerer's Shoes, Shadowflame.
On-hit: Guinsoo's Rageblade, Gluttonous Greaves, Navori Flickerblade.

• The higher the rank, the more AP: about 30% of
AP-or-on-hit games at All ranks, 86% in NA
Challenger. The model's mid-game kill times point
the same way.
• Dusk and Dawn has the best WPA among the big items
(+1.39 on 822 buys), but inside the noise. Terminus
and Rabadon's lean positive too.
• Ruined King leans negative (-3.27 on 452 buys,
noise ±4.6). It is often bought from behind. The
model also rates it a weak first item.
• No stat here can say Nashor's before Dusk; the
u.gg AP core is Dusk first. That call is the
model's, at a ~10% edge.
• Patch 16.22 was too young (705 NA Diamond+ Kog
games on u.gg). Numbers above are copied from the
"carry into fed assassins" page.
